questions.prompt: A nurse is teaching a nursing student about proprioception. Which statement by the student indicates understanding?

options.text: It's the feedback between my muscles and brain that tells me where my body is.

options.rationale: That describes tendons, not proprioception.

options.text: It's the fluid inside my joints that lets them bend.
options.rationale: That describes synovial joints.

options.text: It's the heat my muscles make when I shiver.

options.text: Tendons connect muscle to bone, and ligaments connect bone to bone.

options.text: Ligaments connect muscle to bone, and tendons connect bone to bone.

options.text: Tendons let the ends of the bones glide and absorb shock.

options.text: Ligaments contract to pull on the bones and create movement.

options.text: Your bones are connected to each other by tendons.

options.text: Your bones rebuild faster than your muscles after a period of bed rest.
options.rationale: Bone takes longer to rebuild than muscle.
